analysis:
The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md: it bumps the "Last updated" date (line 3) and rewrites the Qwen27 TP assistant setup paragraph (line 2456). The supplied units are base_text for lines 1237-2116 of that file. They show unchanged surrounding documentation (status, doctor, models, logs, report, paths), and the changed lines at 3 and ~2456 fall outside the supplied excerpts. I judged the change from the patch excerpt. The patch excerpt is truncated, so I could not see every changed line.

The new paragraph says plain `darkbloom cluster` serves through the coordinator and, under the default `auto`, plans the model without the assistant. It says the assistant is not qualified for public traffic, and that explicit `on` keeps the assistant but then the pair is not offered to the coordinator. This is a documentation statement of a more conservative policy. It does not weaken a control, add attack surface, or conflict with the TB-002, TB-007, TB-009 or TB-011 assumptions or with T-041. No code, key handling, authorization, attestation or cache behavior changed in this diff.

The behavior described (auto excluding the assistant for coordinator-registered setups, `on` withholding the pair from the coordinator) is implemented elsewhere and was not supplied, so I cannot verify the docs match the code. If the implementation differs, there could be a doc-drift issue. That is an integration question about the unverified contract, not a finding. Nothing in the visible changes needs a threat-model update.
